title: Bug Report
raw_input:
Act as a Principal AI Full-Stack Architect. I need to update my React frontend and backend integration for my "Agentic Defect Analysis System" (ASBA).
Currently, my file-upload and text-paste pipeline successfully runs the multi-agent workflow (Triage, Log Parser, Vector RAG Matcher, and Remediation). I need you to build the complete, functional code so that my new features—specifically the conversational "Ask RAG AI" drawer and the Voice-Activated Mic button—fully execute this exact same end-to-end bug analysis workflow.
Please generate the complete production-ready code implementation for:
1. Unified Bug Ingestion Handler (`handleUnifiedBugSubmission(inputData)`):
- Whether the input comes from a pasted text file, a PDF upload, a typed chat prompt in the "Ask RAG AI" drawer, or a spoken voice transcription from the microphone, it must route through the exact same parsing and agentic pipeline.
- It should extract error traces, trigger vector similarity search against our historical JSON/ChromaDB knowledge base, and render the structured findings on the dashboard.
2. Interactive "Ask RAG AI" Drawer & Voice Integration Component:
- A fully styled slide-out or modal drawer titled "Ask RAG AI Assistant".
- Includes a text input field AND a working Web Speech API microphone button (`webkitSpeechRecognition`).
- When an engineer types a bug query or speaks into the mic (e.g., "Have we seen an AttributeError in processor.py before?"), it converts speech to text, sends it to the RAG backend, and streams/renders the exact matching historical bugs, root causes, and fix recommendations right inside the drawer.
3. Complete State Synchronization:
- Ensure that interacting with the AI assistant or voice query dynamically updates the main dashboard's active findings and control room state seamlessly without throwing errors.
Provide clean, modular, and fully written-out React component logic with dark-mode glassmorphic styling matching my existing enterprise dashboard aesthetic.
